description: Header file defining the CalculatorManager class, enums for calculator modes, precision, and memory commands, along with method declarations for calculator operations and display updates within the CalculationManager namespace.

classes.name: CalculatorManager
classes.description: Manages calculator operations, modes, history, and display updates, implementing ICalcDisplay interface.

methods.name: SetPrimaryDisplay
methods.description: Sets the primary display string and error state.

methods.name: SetIsInError
methods.description: Sets the error state of the display.

methods.name: SetExpressionDisplay
methods.description: Updates the expression display with tokens and commands.

methods.name: OnHistoryItemAdded
methods.description: Handles addition of a history item.

methods.name: OnNoRightParenAdded
methods.description: Handles event when no right parenthesis is added.

methods.name: DisplayPasteError
methods.description: Displays an error related to paste operation.

methods.name: MaxDigitsReached
methods.description: Handles scenario when maximum digits are reached.

methods.name: BinaryOperatorReceived
methods.description: Handles receipt of a binary operator.

methods.name: MemoryItemChanged
methods.description: Handles change in a memory item.

methods.name: CalculatorManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing display callback and resource provider.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets calculator state, optionally clearing memory.

methods.name: SendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to the calculator engine.

methods.name: MemorizedNumberAdd
methods.description: Adds a number to memorized value.

methods.name: MemorizedNumberSubtract
methods.description: Subtracts a number from memorized value.

methods.name: IsEngineRecording
methods.description: Checks if the engine is recording.

methods.name: GetResultForRadix
methods.description: Gets calculation result formatted for a specific radix and precision.

methods.name: GetHistoryItems
methods.description: Retrieves history items for current or specific mode.

methods.name: SetInHistoryItemLoadMode
methods.description: Sets whether in history item load mode.

methods.name: GetDisplayCommandsSnapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of display commands.
